Cytocast | Drug safety platform Skip to content Open menu Publications Team Careers Contact Request a demo DRUG SAFETY PLATFORM Drug safety engineered, not discovered. Cytocast maps the mechanistic chain from compound to clinical side effect, pathway by pathway, so drug teams see not just what will fail but which off-target causes it. Request a demo Explore the platform â From compound to clinical insight 01 Compound Structure-based input â 02 Off-target Binding predictions across 7,700+ proteins â 03 Perturbed pathway Propagation through protein complexes and pathways â 04 Tissue effect Simulated across 15 human tissues â 05 Predicted side effect 1,200+ side-effect endpoints â WHY IT MATTERS Drug teams see fragments of safety risk. We connect them. Disconnected safety evidence can leave critical liabilities unresolved during development. Substantial time and money may therefore be invested before clinically relevant side effects emerge, sometimes only after compounds reach patients. We add the missing piece: predicted clinical side effects to reduce cost, time, unnecessary animal studies, and patient harm. HOW IT WORKS From structure to adverse event. Every step grounded in biology. Every prediction connected to a mechanism. 01 INTERACTION PREDICTION Predict (off)target interactions Deep-learning models screen candidate structures across a broad protein space to predict potential on-target and off-target interactions. 02 MECHANISTIC SIMULATION Model biological effects across 15 tissues Predicted interactions are propagated through tissue-specific protein complexes, signaling networks, and biological pathways to simulate downstream effects. 03 SIDE-EFFECT MAPPING Connect perturbed mechanisms to clinical outcomes Changes in protein complexes and pathways are mapped to 1,200+ clinically defined side-effect endpoints. Explore the digital twin architecture + Compound information, protein interactions, and clinical side-effect data connect through the Cytocast Digital Twin Platform. Select the diagram to view it full size PRODUCT One platform for every critical safety decision. Cytocast supports compound selection from early discovery to preclinical nomination, adapting the depth of analysis to each development stage. Hit to lead 01 Cytocast Screener Identify early side-effect signals across large compound sets and eliminate weaker candidates before committing significant resources. Lead optimization 02 Cytocast Optimizer Rank candidates by predicted safety profile and understand the protein interactions, pathways, and tissue effects behind their differences. Preclinical & IND-enabling 03 Cytocast Nominator Build a decision-grade safety profile combining clinically relevant side-effect predictions with traceable biological mechanisms to support candidate advancement. WHY US The full body. Not a handful of endpoints. Explore our science â 1,200+ Other AI and simulation tools focus on a handful of toxicity endpoints. Cytocast predicts over 1,200 clinically relevant side effects across the full body. 300+ Our performance on the 300+ best predictable side effects outperforms translation accuracy from animal models. Research-first Built by professors in systems biology and computational biology, our platform is grounded in world-class science and led by a research-first team. Careers at Cytocast.
Careers at Cytocast.
Careers | Cytocast Skip to content Open menu Publications Team Careers Contact Request a demo Work with us Our team members are the core of our work, and the inspiration to keep moving forward. Together we've created a one-of-a-kind cell simulation platform that's unique in the world. We foster a creative and transformative culture that encourages collaboration and innovation, and together our mission is to make a difference in the lives of patients through drug discovery, development, and precision medicine. We couldn't have made the progress we have without dedicated and talented people like you. Open positions Machine Learning Researcher Budapest Full-time Biotechnology View role Close role Cytocast is a Hungarian biotech startup behind the Cytocast Digital Twin Patient, an advanced software solution that predicts drug side effects by simulating billions of molecular interactions within human cells. Relying on a wide range of available information on how complex cellular processes work, our solution is revolutionizing drug discovery by accelerating the overall process, reducing costs, and increasing clinical trial success rates. Our ultimate goal is to build a Digital Twin that can incorporate an individual patientâs data and suggest personalized treatments. Essential Duties Include but Are Not Limited To Â Be part of the ongoing research and developmentÂ Write machine learning modules that integrate into our systemsÂ Prepare internal reports on KPIs, and explore methods and tools to further improve themÂ Apply data engineering skills to locate, extract, and prepare data for machine learning tasks when needed.Â This position will focus on building and extending existing solutions to predict drug side effects from changes in how proteins interact due to perturbations. A background in biology or medicine is not required, and this role does not involve using image-processing models.Â What we expect Â Medior-level machine learning skills (at least two years of experience in an ML-related position)Â Deep understanding of statistics, model evaluation and common biasesÂ Familiarity with Pytorch or Tensorflow, Scikit-learn, PandasÂ Experience with neural networksÂ At least medium English working proficiencyÂ Data visualizations skillsÂ Experience with critical evaluation of SOTA publications, and implementation of described methodsÂ Preferred skills Â Experience with bioinformatics (biological background or worked with healthcare data)Â Experiment logging tools: Tensorboard, MLFlow or similarÂ Ability to optimize application performance in Python codebaseÂ Experience with Docker technologyÂ Experience with structural biology (and ML models predicting it, e.g. AlphaFold)Â Familiar withÂ unit testing (with frameworks like pytest or similar)Â What we offer We offer a full-time job with a competitive salary and other benefits. You will be working with a dynamic, youthful team of 15 people. We are working in a hybrid setup, you can work remotely up to three days a week, with at least two days a week in our Budapest downtown office. How to Apply Please, submit your CV to job@cytocast.com with a short cover letter in the email body. Apply for this role Vice President of Research Budapest Full-time Biotechnology View role Close role Cytocast is a Hungarian biotech startup developing AI-powered simulations of human cells to accelerate drug discovery and predict drug side effects through computational biology and machine learning.Â Position OverviewÂ We are looking for a VP of Research to lead our multidisciplinary research team at the intersection of Machine Learning, Bioinformatics, and Computational Biology. In this role, you will drive scientific projects, mentor researchers, and help shape the future of our AI-powered biological simulation platform.Â The ideal candidate combines strong scientific expertise with leadership skills and enjoys working in a fast-paced startup environment.Â Â Essential Duties Include but Are Not Limited ToÂ Follow the ongoing and relevant scientific literature and incorporate it into our platform.Â Plan, coordinate, and supervise research projects from ideation to execution. Â Lead and mentor a team of researchers, bioinformaticians, and machine learning engineers.Â Participate in biological conceptualization and prototype how a cell would react under certain conditions.Â Drive the integration of machine learning methods into bioinformatics workflows. Â Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and domain experts. Â Apply statistical methods and data analysis to biological and biomedical datasets. Â Evaluate new scientific findings and incorporate relevant advances into our platform.Â Â What we expect PhD or MSc in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.Â 3â5+ years of professional research experienceÂ 2+ years of industry (or at least market-driven) experienceÂ Hands-on experience applying Machine Learning to biological or biomedical problemsÂ Strong background in bioinformatics and analysis of large-scale biological datasetsÂ Solid knowledge of statistics, experimental design, and statistical data analysisÂ Strong communication skills and professional English proficiencyÂ Preferred skills Experience with leadership or project management responsibilitiesÂ Experience within drug development or pharma industryÂ Scientific publications in relevant fields are an advantageÂ What we offer We offer a full-time job with a competitive salary and other benefits.Â We are working in a hybrid setup, you can work remotely up to 3 days a week, with at least two days a week in our Budapest downtown office.Â Â How to ApplyÂ Please, submit your CV to job@cytocast.com with a short cover letter in the email body, stating whether you have a right to work in Hungary.Â The privacy of your personal information is important to us. We collect, use, and store your personal information in accordance with the requirements of the applicable data privacy rules, including specifically the General Data Protection Regulation.Â Apply for this role Drug safety engineered, not discovered. Privacy Policy | Cytocast
How Cytocast collects, uses, and processes personal data, and how to contact us about your privacy rights.
How Cytocast collects, uses, and processes personal data, and how to contact us about your privacy rights.
Privacy Policy | Cytocast Skip to content Open menu Publications Team Careers Contact Request a demo Privacy Policy Who We Are Cytocast collects and processes personal data when visitors contact us, request information, or submit a form to access a sample report or other gated resource. Personal Data We Collect For gated report downloads, we collect the full name and email address submitted in the form, the requested resource, consent confirmation, and a submission timestamp. Contact forms may also collect company, area of interest, and message details. Purpose of Processing We use this information to provide access to the requested report, maintain a record of consent, respond to inquiries, and send future Cytocast marketing communications such as newsletters, product updates, or related scientific and commercial information. Legal Basis and Consent Marketing communication is based on explicit consent. The consent checkbox is mandatory for gated report access and is not pre-selected. You may withdraw consent at any time by contacting us at info@cytocast.com . Storage and Processing Form submissions are processed through Formspree and made available to Cytocast for follow-up and consent recordkeeping. We restrict access to submitted data to personnel and service providers who need it for the purposes described in this policy. Retention We retain personal data for as long as necessary to provide the requested information, maintain consent records, support legitimate business follow-up, or comply with legal obligations. If you withdraw consent, we will stop sending marketing communications. Your Rights Subject to applicable law, including GDPR, you may request access, correction, deletion, restriction, portability, or objection to processing of your personal data. You may also withdraw consent for marketing communication at any time. Contact For privacy requests or questions, contact Cytocast at info@cytocast.com . Drug safety engineered, not discovered.
